fixes.explanation: Forgetting? Friend, that's a whole different mess. The proverb says the simple man "…believes every word…" and he doesn't lose a single one, he swallows them all! I think he'd believe a stranger who said the oven turns itself on. The prudent man is the one who "…watches his steps." (Proverbs 14:15)

Divides? Oooh, friend, I see why that one tempted you. A nation splitting in two sounds like trouble, and it is, but it's not the word the proverb picked. It says "Righteousness exalts a nation…" and exalts means lifted UP, up, up! That's the word the first blank is hungry for. (Proverbs 14:34)
